name: Ke Zunhong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun China (2010-2026)
forbes_bio: Ke Zunhong chairs Chengdu Kanghong Pharmaceutical, which makes drugs that treat nervous system, eyes and digestion problems.
Ke once worked in the pharmacy department at a hospital in Chengdu, where Kanghong is headquartered.
Kanghong went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2015.

name: Jaime Botin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2020); Forbes annual (2014-2019); Hurun Global (2017-2024)
forbes_bio: Jaime Botín is the largest shareholder of Spanish bank Bankinter S.A. and a member of a storied Spanish banking family.
Botín's great grandfather founded Spain's largest bank, Santander. His grandfather, father, and brother Emilio have all been presidents of the bank.
He previously served as the vice chairman of Santander and left that role in 2004; he has continued to increase his stake in Bankinter.

name: Alfred Oetker
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Alfred Oetker and his brother are the co-CEOs and owners of Geschwister Oetker, a German holding company with brands spanning wine and spirits, chemicals and luxury hotels.
Geschwister Oetker was formed in 2021 after the Oetker family agreed to divide their $8 billion (sales) conglomerate into two independent groups.
The original business, Dr. August Oetker, began in 1891 when his great-grandfather started selling non-perishable baking powder.
In September of 2024, he and his brother Carl Ferdinand bought out their sister Julia from Geschwister Oetker, assuming full control over the company.
When Alfred's father, Rudolf August, passed away in 2007, ownership of Dr. August Oetker was divided among his eight children from three marriages.
forbes_facts: Alfred has two sons with his wife, Princess Elvira Grimaldi, whose family is the Sicilian branch of the Grimaldis of Genoa and Monaco.
Alfred studied economics at the University of Passau and Oxford, and speaks six languages.

name: George Pastor
forbes_bio: Pastor is the son of Carlos Rodriguez-Pastor, a Peruvian politician who along with outside investors acquired Banco Internacional del Peru in 1994.
His billionaire brother, Carlos, took over leadership of the bank after his father died and has since invested its profits in other businesses.
A political coup sent the family exile in California in the 1980s; when they returned, the elder Rodriguez-Pastor served as Minister of Economy from 1982 to 1984.
The family owns the majority of the publicly traded company Intercorp Financial Services.

name: Marc Lipschultz
sec_insider_companies: BLUE OWL CAPITAL INC. (OWL) - Co-Chief Executive Officer; HESS CORP (HES) - Director
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Marc Lipschultz is a cofounder and co-CEO of Blue Owl, an investment firm specializing in private credit with $250 billion in assets under management.
Lipschultz spent more than 20 years at private equity giant KKR and was its head of energy and infrastructure investments when he left in 2016.
He cofounded Owl Rock Capital in 2016 with Doug Ostrover and Craig Packer, which merged with Dyal Capital to form Blue Owl in 2021.
Lipschultz was promoted from president to co-CEO of Blue Owl alongside Ostrover in May 2023.

name: Sara Blakely
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2012-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Wikidata (2017)
forbes_bio: Sara Blakely is the founder and part owner of shapewear brand Spanx, which sells undergarments, leggings and apparel.
In late 2021, Blackstone bought a majority stake in Spanx in a deal that valued the company at $1.2 billion.
In August 2024, Blakely launched Sneex, a line of high-heeled sneakers priced at $395 and up that she designed to be comfortable.
A onetime door-to-door fax machine salesperson, Blakely first created Spanx using pantyhose to wear under white slacks.
While Spanx is a celebrity favorite, Blakely is becoming a celebrity herself. She was a guest judge on 'Shark Tank' and had a cameo in 'Billions.'
forbes_facts: Blakely's husband Jessie Itzler is the founder of private jet membership company Marquis Jets, which was acquired by NetJets in 2010 for an undisclosed sum.
Blakely owns a minority stake in the Atlanta Hawks, her local NBA team.

name: Meng Qingshan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2009-2026)
forbes_bio: Meng Qingshan chairs Meihua Holdings, a China-based chemicals supplier.
Products include amino acids and seasonons.
Meihua was once known as Wuzhou Minovo.

name: Martin Moller Nielsen
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: Martin Moller Nielsen is a Danish aviation entrepreneur who founded aircraft leasing firm Nordic Aviation Capital in 1990.
A quarter of a century later, he sold a 66% stake in it to private equity firms EQT and Krikbi in a deal that valued the firm at $3.3 billion.
He later brought on Singaporean sovereign wealth fund GIC as an investor and, in 2022, sold the last of his shares in NAC.
Moller Nielsen now runs Axiom Group, his private family office that invests in areas such as renewable energy and real estate.
forbes_facts: Moller Nielsen, a certified pilot by the age of 18, reportedly bought a beaten up aircraft at 21, renovated it, and sold it for a large profit.
NAC initially leased aircraft for humanitarian aid organizations looking to fly into remote areas.

name: Tsuyoshi Matsushita
forbes_bio: Matsushita is the founder of MTG, which develops and sells fitness, health and beauty products and outsources its production.
The company, in which Matsushita has a 70% stake, listed its shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in July 2018.
Soccer phenom Cristiano Ronaldo starred in TV ads for MTG's Sixpad electrical-stimulation muscle machine.
His company developed a line of cosmetics called MDNA Skin with singer Madonna.
Mastushita worked for autoparts giant Denso after high school and started MTG in 1996.
